description: This file implements the EventThread class and related factory functions for managing event-driven threading, including thread creation, execution, synchronization, and cleanup within the firebolt::rialto::common namespace.

classes.name: IEventThreadFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating event thread factories.

classes.name: EventThreadFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the IEventThreadFactory interface, responsible for creating EventThread instances.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Class managing a dedicated thread for event execution, including thread lifecycle, task queue, and synchronization.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IEventThreadFactory instance.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates a new EventThread with the specified thread name.

methods.name: EventThread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the thread with a given name and starts execution.

methods.name: ~EventThread
methods.description: Destructor that signals shutdown, joins the thread, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: threadExecutor
methods.description: Main loop executed by the thread, processing queued functions and handling shutdown.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Ensures all queued tasks are completed by signaling via a semaphore.

methods.name: addImpl
methods.description: Adds a new function to the task queue and notifies the thread.
